item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya grinds a piece of chalk into a fine powder and then stirs some sugar into a glass of water until it can no longer be seen. Which statement best explains what has happened to the chalk and the sugar?

options.A: The chalk and sugar have become nothing, because no large pieces can be seen.
options.B: The chalk and sugar are still present as extremely small particles that are too small to see.
options.C: The sugar has disappeared, but the chalk has changed into a new substance.
options.D: Grinding and dissolving destroy the particles of a substance completely.
